text: Bilot Sharif Temples Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Bilot Sharif Temples Type: Monument - Temple Province: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa District: Dera Ismail Khan Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 7th - early 11th Century CE Description: This is a group of three Hindu temples, A, B, C, spread over an area measuring 500m x 400m secured by a fortification wall, built of dressed stone and in a good state of preservation. Pottery and Kanjur blocks are also visible on the site.
